terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measured game-space dimensions and named canine landmarks; do not substitute humanoid anatomy or photo textures.

objectClass.notes: The generic route is intentional: img2threejs v1.5.1 provides only a humanoid character template.

reasoning: Breed identity depends on a long head, dropped ears, deep brisket, moderate tuck, angled hocks and straight feathered tail.
Gameplay needs independent ear, neck, head, tail and eight leg-segment pivots plus four exact paw markers.
Blue-belton markings must remain sparse and authored rather than becoming uniform procedural noise.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The current runtime already poses a multi-level quadruped hierarchy, so a shallower replacement would be a regression.

resolvedUnknowns: Far-side width and rear spacing use bilateral symmetry checked against the three-quarter references.
The clean orange-belton profile supplies geometry while the admitted blue-belton references supply color zones.
Loose coat motion is represented by rigid, low-count feather masses at gameplay scale.
Toe anatomy is intentionally collapsed into four paw blocks below the gameplay pixel threshold.

anatomy.note: The bundled anatomy schema is humanoid-specific; canine measurements are expressed by the component dimensions and attachment endpoints.

definitionOfDone: The animal reads as an English Setter from side, front-three-quarter and rear-three-quarter views at gameplay and macro distance.
The hierarchy preserves gait, point, retrieve, terrain planting, deterministic capture and disposal contracts.
The high tier remains at or below 4000 triangles and approximately 15 dog draw calls using only the locked Uplandin palette.

featureReviews.notes: Long-head intent is present, but skull, muzzle and dark ear separate into stacked ellipsoids.
Level topline is present; the torso remains a barrel with no setter brisket-to-tuck transition.

visualEvidence.notes: Photo-versus-procedural Tier-1 IoU is advisory here, but its aspect and scale failures agree with visual inspection.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The same-view sheet reads as a generic mannequin dog rather than an English Setter. The failure is implementation-level: the authored component inventory is adequate, but the generator maps organic components to uniformly smooth ellipsoids and does not achieve the specified loft contours.

featureReviews.notes: The longer squared muzzle, substantial skull, and low dark ear read clearly; the skull remains intentionally blocky.
Level topline, deep forechest, and rising abdomen are present, though the show dog's coat mass is intentionally absent.
The tail is articulated at base and mid-flag with shallow two-sided feather locks; close views remain visibly stylized.
Fore and hind chains articulate and plant correctly; sparse rigid furnishings replace fur cards to preserve the game budget.

visualEvidence.notes: Photo and render are aspect-aligned for inspection. Tier-1 remains a hard fail and is not overridden; the repo's documented photo-versus-procedural caveat applies. Stop records a bounded game-ready approximation, not a strict reference reconstruction pass.
visualEvidence.aiVisionNotes: The integrated model now reads as an English Setter in Uplandin's deliberately sparse low-poly language. The long head, drop ears, topline, brisket-to-tuck transition, flag tail, and angulated limbs are coherent and animated. The dominant remaining mismatch is not topology failure but the intentional absence of the reference dog's dense show coat and soft feather volume.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Do not trade deterministic paw planting or breed silhouette for hidden micro detail.

proceduralStrategy: Generate the seven-part macro blockout through img2threejs to test the admitted spec.
Replace generic ellipsoids with low-ring canine lofts while preserving generated semantic node names.
Add eight leg segments, four paw blocks, two ear flaps and two tail pivots as independently animated groups.
Encode coat zones and sparse flecks in vertex colors using the existing deterministic art seed.
Run visual, light, paw-gap, triangle, draw-call, build and unit-test gates before integration.
assumptions: The existing 0.55m gameplay scale is authoritative over breed inches.
Bilateral geometry plus admitted three-quarter views is sufficient for hidden-side reconstruction.
Rigid faceted feather locks are appropriate to the project style.
risks: A procedural low-poly build will improve breed silhouette, not reproduce individual coat hair.
The img2threejs generator is an intake and blockout aid here because v1.5.1 has no quadruped template.
